rule: The board is the modified mill board shown in the figure. The two players take turns placing red and blue discs on the board. (You may not place a disc on a cell that already holds a disc of either colour.) The player who first gets three of their own discs adjacent in a line wins. If every cell holds a disc but neither colour has three adjacent discs in a line, then the second player wins.
step: Click an empty cell to place a disc on it.
